::: {.obsidian-jsa}
:::

State the purpose of the analysis. Name the job, the location, and
the people who carry it out.

# Job steps

Break the job into steps. Use a table with step, hazard, control,
and residual risk columns.

# Personal protective equipment

State the PPE required for each step.

# Emergency arrangements

State the emergency response for the work. Name the first aid
provision and the emergency contact.

# Approval

State who approves the analysis and the review date.
